The job

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 
 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Organize the collection of completed orders using the SAP transport module or by entering shipments into the appropriate transport software.
 
• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
 
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.
 
• Collaborate with various departments and external partners to resolve delivery issues and transport-related complaints.
 
• Support the loading of pallets and cartons onto trucks when required.
 
• Accept small incoming shipments and coordinate their internal distribution on site.
 
• Provide administrative support to the Logistics Transport Supervisor.
 
• Continuously identify opportunities to optimize transport efficiency and reduce shipping costs. 

Your Profile
 

 
• Strong experience and knowledge in transport and logistics operations.
 
• Proven experience with the SAP transport module.
 
• Knowledge of customs regulations is an asset.
 
• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
 
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
 
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
 
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
 
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

You will be responsible for:
 

 
• Moving and dragging foam blocks
 
• Manually feeding the machine
 
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor
 
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized
 
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process 

 
• You speak Dutch or English.
 
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.
 
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.
 
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.
 
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.
 
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

Our client is a leading international provider of financial and retail services, operating a large network of airport and travel retail locations across multiple countries. The company serves millions of customers every year through a combination of foreign exchange, payment, and customer-focused retail services.As part of its continued growth, our client is seeking an experienced Airport Retail & Foreign Exchange Manager to lead its Brussels Airport operations.

Jobomschrijving

Commercial & Business Leadership

• Own and develop the overall commercial performance of the airport business.
• Drive revenue growth across all foreign exchange and retail activities.
• Identify opportunities to increase transaction volumes, customer conversion, and profitability.
• Monitor key commercial KPIs and implement action plans to exceed targets.
• Collaborate with senior leadership to define and execute local business strategies.
Foreign Exchange Operations

• Lead and optimize all currency exchange activities across multiple airport locations.
• Ensure accurate execution of foreign exchange transactions and adherence to operational procedures.
• Monitor market trends and customer behaviors to maximize foreign exchange sales opportunities.
• Maintain the highest standards of cash management, reconciliation, and financial controls.
• Ensure strict compliance with all regulatory and financial service requirements.
Leadership & People Management

• Lead, coach, and develop a management team as well as a sizeable frontline workforce.
• Create a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer service, and commercial results.
• Recruit, train, mentor, and retain top talent.
• Manage workforce planning, scheduling, performance reviews, and succession planning.
• Foster employee engagement and maintain strong team morale within a demanding operational environment.
Operational Excellence

• Ensure smooth day-to-day operations across all airport locations.
• Maintain exceptional standards regarding customer experience, store presentation, security, and operational efficiency.
• Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and service quality.
• Conduct regular site visits, audits, and compliance reviews.
Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure full adherence to airport regulations, internal policies, AML requirements, security procedures, and financial controls.
• Oversee cash handling processes and conduct regular operational audits.
• Manage risk proactively while maintaining a customer-centric approach.

Mandatory Experience

• Significant experience managing foreign exchange (currency exchange) operations within an airport, travel retail, financial services, or related environment.
• Strong background managing operations in a busy airport retail environment.
• Proven experience leading large, multicultural teams through layers of management.
• Demonstrated success in delivering commercial growth and operational improvements.
• Experience managing multiple points of sale or multi-site retail operations.
Leadership Competencies

• Strong people leadership and coaching capabilities.
• Ability to inspire, engage, and unite teams around ambitious objectives.
• Excellent operational and organizational skills.
• Strong analytical mindset with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
• Excellent conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills.
Language Requirements

• Full professional proficiency in English.
• French and/or Dutch highly desirable.
• Additional languages are considered a strong asset.

We are an internationally recognised recruitment consultancy with a strong reputation for expertise, quality, and career development. Operating in a dynamic and people-focused environment, they offer ambitious professionals the opportunity to build a rewarding career while making a real impact on businesses and individuals

Jobomschrijving

• Resilient, results-oriented, and proactive

• Interested in sales, recruitment, and people management

Our client is an internationally active industrial manufacturing organisation with a strong reputation located in the south of Ghent. The company operates across multiple countries and provides employees with a collaborative, people-focused environment where continuous improvement, operational excellence, and personal development are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

As Fleet Coordinator your key responsibilities are:

• Act as the primary point of contact for fleet-related matters across EMEA, supporting employees and coordinating with leasing partners
• Manage the full vehicle lifecycle, including vehicle ordering, registration, insurance, maintenance, and lease returns
• Maintain accurate fleet records covering vehicles, drivers, contracts, mileage, and renewals
• Coordinate damage cases, fines, insurance claims, and country-specific fleet requirements
• Support employee onboarding through vehicle allocation, documentation management, and policy communication
• Manage indirect purchasing activities for various categories and provide backup support to the purchasing team
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by standardising processes, developing SOPs, monitoring KPIs, and enhancing system efficiency
You will be back up of your colleagues from indirect procurment and will report to the head of Supply Chain.

• You obtained a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, or a related field
• You have relevant working experience in in fleet management
• Experience in procurement or purchasing is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on compliance and process accuracy
• Fluency in English is essential; Dutch and/or French is highly preferred
• Proficient with Microsoft 365 and comfortable working with ERP and fleet management systems 
• You have a valid working permit

For a leading manufacturer in the machine building industry in the region, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this key engineering role, you will act as the technical owner for the complete electrical hardware design, ensuring every machine meets the highest quality and safety standards!

As Senior Electrical Engineer, you will take full ownership of the electrical engineering lifecycle:

• Concept & Project Planning: Participate in multidisciplinary project design meetings with mechanical and software engineers from the concept phase onwards, creating realistic project schedules and milestones.
• Electrical Design (EPLAN P8 & ProPanel): Translate draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed hardware guidelines. Design and adapt electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 and create 3D panel/enclosure layouts in EPLAN ProPanel.
• Standards & Compliance: Ensure all designs strictly comply with European directives and international regulations (e.g., EN 60204, Machinery Directive, EMC, LVD).
• ERP & Production Follow-Up: Create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and master BOMs for standard machinery. Closely monitor electrical assembly during the build phase in the workshop.
• Standardization & Mentorship: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices. Review schematics with colleagues, offer technical guidance, and actively drive departmental standardization initiatives.

• Education & Experience: You hold a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences (Electromechanics / Electrotechnics) or possess equivalent experience. You have at least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building sector.
• Software & Standards: Strong proficiency in EPLAN P8 is required (hands-on experience with EPLAN ProPanel is a major plus). Solid working knowledge of European electrical safety standards (familiarity with UL standards for the North American market is an asset).
• Key Strengths: You possess an analytical mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and a structured way of working.
• Languages & Communication: Excellent communication skills in both English and Dutch, with a collaborative team spirit suited for an international environment.

jobs.description:
Residence Inn by Marriott is an extended stay brand whereby our guests stay for longer periods of time. It is up to us to make them feel at home with our family of associates! All rooms are suites with more living and working space, than you would find in an any other hotel room, including a fully equipped kitchen in every suite! Our guests, The Maximisers, want to maximize their stay and we are here to help them do that, by offering grocery services, complimentary daily breakfast and of course all the places to be in Brussels!
 

Vertiq Hospitality Partners, formerly known as Cycas hospitality, is a leading European hospitality investment and management company, operating a diverse portfolio of hotels and serviced apartments accross eight countries.
 

Our vision is to be the trusted operating partner in European hospitality invevstments and every member of our team must play their part in delivering exceptional service to our guests, our owners, and our colleagues in order to achieve this. With a real focus on performance, people, quality, profit, and communities, team members transform hotels.
 

Your role:
 
 

• Your role will be to ensure the cleaning and tidiness of the rooms and common areas of the hotel, 

• You will check the proper functioning of the equipment and report any anomaly to the General Manager, 

• You will respect the safety and hygiene standards, 

• You will respect the procedures and standards of the hotel, 

• You will take care of the well-being of the customers.  

Our job isn't over until we get a smile!

What we ask of you:
 
 

• 1 year of experience in similar role 

• Allowed to work in the EU 

• Bilingual in the following languages: English/ French and/or Dutch 

• Critical thinker and problem-solving skills 

• Team player 

• Great interpersonal and communication skills 

• Customer-oriented mindset 

• Willing to work on a flexible/standby basis (Interim or Flexi-job)

For our client in Tielt, specialized in recycling foam materiales is looking for an extra co-worker.

Tasks:

- setting up and starting the machine

- quality control

- discharge and supply of raw materials with forklift truck

- keeping work area tidy

- You have experience driving a forklift

- You have no physical complaints

- You speak, understand and read English well

- Working in 2 shifts.

Main Responsibilities

Editorial Duties

• Monitor and select relevant stories for daily digital coverage, prioritizing according to editorial value and available resources.
• React promptly to breaking news, ensuring accurate and timely publication.
• Produce clear, engaging, and factual content that aligns with Euronews' editorial standards.
• Coordinate with editors and other newsroom staff to ensure coherent and comprehensive coverage.
• Apply sound editorial judgment and perform fact-checking to ensure accuracy and balance.
• Analyze current events and contribute to editorial planning with informed insights.
• Edit and proofread articles written by other Euronews journalists.
• Curate and update the Euronews digital front page, maintaining a balanced and relevant news selection.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of editorial processes and workflows.
Technical and Organizational Duties

• Use newsroom production systems and digital publishing tools efficiently.
• Ensure the proper integration of multimedia elements in digital content.
• Collaborate with technical and editorial teams to resolve production issues when necessary.
• Maintain awareness of digital journalism trends and tools relevant to the role. 
Skills and Qualifications

Education and Experience

• Master education degree (minimum 4-5 years) in journalism or a related field from a recognised University
• Minimum of two (2) years' professional experience in journalism, including experience with breaking and hard news.
• Prior experience in an international or fast-paced newsroom environment is highly desirable.
• Excellent command of English (C2) and French (C2); knowledge of other Euronews languages is an asset.
• Strong understanding of European and international current affairs.
• Good knowledge of digital content production methods and audience consumption trends.
Technical Skills

• Proficiency in newsroom production systems and digital content management tools.
• Strong fact-checking and editing abilities.
• Analytical skills and problem-solving capabilities relevant to editorial production.
• Familiarity with live reporting and broadcast procedures is an advantage.
Interpersonal Skills

• Ability to work effectively in a team and within an editorial hierarchy.
• Capacity to perform under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commitment to Euronews' editorial values and journalistic standards of accuracy, impartiality, and fairness.

Job description 
 What will you do? 
    
• 
        
Play the early bird: The road is yours while the rest of the world is still hitting snooze.

    
    
• 
        
Embrace variety: Shuttle between regional clients carrying agricultural products, sand, gravel, or waste (no ADR stress!).

    
    
• 
        
Be versatile: Switch smoothly between a tipper and a curtain-sider like it's nothing.

    
    
• 
        
Build some muscle: A physical challenge doesn't scare you off.

    

 Requirements 
 Who are you? 
    
• 
        
You hold a CE License + Code 95 (crucial, otherwise things get awkward with the police).

    
    
• 
        
You speak Dutch, French, or English (as long as we can understand each other by the coffee machine).

    
    
• 
        
You are flexible, precise, and treat your truck as if it were your own.

    
    
• 
        
Want extra hours? Great! More hours = more cash.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do we expect?

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English. You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents. You have some experience driving a mega trailer. Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You possess a CE driving license and all necessary documents (Code 95, driver card).
    
• You have experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
    
• You enjoy working with different types of trailers and various goods. No day is the same!
    
• Physically demanding work does not deter you, and you carry out your tasks with a smile.
    
• You have your own transportation to get to the site.

Job description 

For our client, a renowned logistics company, we are looking for a motivated and experienced C Driver for the distribution center in Merelbeke. As a C Driver, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently transporting goods to various locations in East and West Flanders.

Tasks and responsibilities:

    
• Loading and unloading goods (various, food (including alcohol) and non-food) on pallets using an electric pallet truck.
    
• Safely and timely delivering goods to customers in East and West Flanders.
    
• Correctly filling out freight documents and maintaining administration.
    
• Maintaining and keeping the truck clean.
    
• Adhering to traffic rules and safety regulations.
    
• Providing customer-friendly service.

 Requirements 

    
• In possession of a valid driver's license C and code 95. Experience as a C Chauffeur, preferably in distribution.
    
• Good knowledge of the roads in East and West Flanders.
    
• Physically fit and able to load and unload independently.
    
• Customer-oriented, flexible, and reliable.
    
• Able to work independently.
    
• You speak good Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 
 What will you do?

As a CE Driver (ADR), you will perform irregular international routes throughout Europe. You will operate in a high-stakes environment where safety, precision, and strict adherence to procedures are the top priorities.

    
• 
        
Commute with ease: Depart from home in a company car heading towards Fleurus.

    
    
• 
        
Specialized Cargo: Transport radioactive and nuclear materials.

    
    
• 
        
Versatile Fleet: Operate both open and closed trailers equipped for ADR Tank and ADR Class 7.

    
    
• 
        
International Scope: Varied, non-fixed international routes.

    
    
• 
        
Teamwork: Work in double-crew shifts.

    
    
• 
        
Client Relations: Direct interaction with customers during delivery, following rigorous security protocols.

    
    
• 
        
Regulatory Contact: Regular interaction with authorities and inspection services.

    
    
• 
        
Hands-on Work: Responsible for loading and unloading, including securing cargo (strapping).

    
    
• 
        
Administration: Accurate management of transport documents and safety checklists.

    
    
• 
        
Flexibility: A five-day work week with variable hours; weekend work may be required based on planning.

    

 Requirements 
 What are we looking for?

We are seeking an experienced driver who treats responsibility and discretion with the utmost seriousness.

    
• 
        
Qualifications: Valid License CE with proven experience in international transport.

    
    
• 
        
Certifications: ADR Tank and ADR Class 7 (or a willingness to obtain these through our training program).

    
    
• 
        
Compliance: Medically fit and all mandatory documentation in order.

    
    
• 
        
Languages: Good proficiency in Dutch, French, and English. (Knowledge of German is a strong asset).

    
    
• 
        
Soft Skills: Independent, meticulous, and resilient under pressure.

    
    
• 
        
Professionalism: A professional attitude toward clients and official authorities.

    
    
• 
        
Mindset: A team player who can also excel when working independently.

Job description 

Our client in the Kortrijk/Menen region is looking for CE drivers for transporting sea containers. Usually for picking up and dropping off, but sometimes also just unloading at the quay. Nice working days of approximately 12 hours and home every day.

Loading and unloading locations at terminals in the ports of Ghent/Antwerp and at the client's warehouses and companies.

 Requirements 

You are motivated to work in the ports. You have a valid CE driving license with C95.

You have a good knowledge of Dutch, English, or French.

You live in the Kortrijk/Westhoek region.

Job description 

The Adventures of an International Driver Are you ready to take the wheel and turn every trip into an adventure? As an international driver, you’ll be transporting goods all across Europe—think the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France—behind the wheel of a sleek tarpaulin truck.

From candy to concrete, meat to zinc on pallets, no two loads are ever the same. It’s like a market of surprises—just with more driving and fewer small talk breaks!

Planning and timing are your superpowers. You’ll keep trips efficient, respect driving and rest rules, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination perfectly. Customers? Think of them as friends—you’ll want to impress every single one.

Flexibility and independence are key. Unexpected challenges? You handle them like a pro. One thing’s for sure: life as an international driver is never boring, always full of variety, and packed with adventure.

 Requirements 

Driving License CE + Code 95 Reliable, Flexible

I can communicate in Dutch, French, and English. That's convenient, right? No language barriers here, just a glass wall full of fun!
